excerpt.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
excerpt.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出灵能光环的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 它被称为“灵能光环”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 由于我们与[fromfrom.GetName]的关系[GetLessThanRivalAdj]良好，我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
texts.en: Given our [GetLessThanRivalAdj]favorable relations with the [fromfrom.GetName], we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

texts.zh: 据[GetTelepathPlural]的说法，它能释放[GetBenevolentRivalAdj]的意志，因此我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
texts.en: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.
